# Data preparation
In this example data, we don't have any subjects with retroprogressive diagnosis. Additional data manipulations or cleaning will be required for subjects with retroprogressive diagnoses.

```{r}
# read-in demonstration data
demo_data = readr::read_csv("Data/Example_data.csv")

# generate indicator functions
## generating the diagnosis sequance for each subject
demo_dat %<>% group_by(subj_id) %>% mutate(dx_seq = rle(diagnosis)$values %>% paste0(collapse = "-")) %>% ungroup()
demo_dat$dx_seq %>% table

# only keeping subjects with at least one of observed NC-to-MCI and MCI-to-AD conversions, and no retroprogressive conversions (i.e., converting from AD to NC or MCI)
demo_dat %<>% subset(dx_seq %in% c("NC-MCI", "NC-AD", "MCI-AD", "NC-MCI-AD"))

# generating indicator variables
## MCI convertors (the subjects who have MCI conversion)
demo_dat$I_MCI = ifelse(demo_dat$dx_seq %in% c("NC-MCI", "NC-MCI-AD"), 1, 0)
## AD convertors (the subjects who have AD conversions)
demo_dat$I_AD = ifelse(demo_dat$dx_seq %in% c("NC-AD", "MCI-AD", "NC-MCI-AD"), 1, 0)

# calcualte ages at MCI and AD diagnosis
demo_dat$MCI_age = demo_dat$AD_age = 9999
## the age(s) during MCI
demo_dat$MCI_age[demo_dat$diagnosis == "MCI"] = demo_dat$age[demo_dat$diagnosis == "MCI"]
## the age recorded during AD
demo_dat$AD_age[demo_dat$diagnosis == "AD"] = demo_dat$age[demo_dat$diagnosis == "AD"]
## the age at MCI and the age at AD
demo_dat %<>% group_by(subj_id) %>% mutate(MCI_age = min(MCI_age, na.rm = TRUE), AD_age = min(AD_age, na.rm = TRUE))

# Derive the relative times to MCI and AD
## Defined as `age at visit` - `age at MCI/AD`
demo_dat$time_to_MCI = NA
demo_dat$time_to_MCI = demo_dat$age - demo_dat$MCI_age
demo_dat$time_to_AD = NA
demo_dat$time_to_AD = demo_dat$age - demo_dat$AD_age

# Derive the "time to event" variable
demo_dat$t_event = demo_dat$time_to_AD
## MCI convertors: use `time to MCI conversion`
demo_dat$t_event[demo_dat$I_MCI == 1] = demo_dat$time_to_MCI[demo_dat$I_MCI == 1]
## only-AD convertors (i.e., having MCI-to-AD or  conversion but no NC-to-MCI conversion)
demo_dat$t_event[demo_dat$I_AD == 1 & demo_dat$I_MCI == 0] = demo_dat$time_to_AD[demo_dat$I_AD == 1 & demo_dat$I_MCI == 0]

# Derive the 'age at event" variable
demo_dat$age_event = demo_dat$AD_age
## MCI convertors: age at MCI conversion
demo_dat$age_event[demo_dat$I_MCI == 1] = demo_dat$MCI_age[demo_dat$I_MCI == 1]
## only-AD convertors (i.e., having MCI-to-AD or  conversion but no NC-to-MCI conversion): use age at AD conversion
demo_dat$age_event[demo_dat$I_AD == 1 & demo_dat$I_MCI == 0] = demo_dat$AD_age[demo_dat$I_AD == 1 & demo_dat$I_MCI == 0]

head(demo_dat)
```



# Model fitting

## SMM model
```{r}
# data
dat_smm = subset(demo_dat, I_AD == 1)
dat_smm = dat_smm[order(dat_smm$study, dat_smm$subj_id, dat_smm$age), ]
# prior specification
prior_spec <- prior(normal(0, 1), nlpar = "theta0") + 
              prior(normal(0, 1), nlpar = "theta1") + 
              prior(normal(0, 1), nlpar = "tau")
  
set.seed(2024)
# model fitting
smm_fit <- brm(bf( Y ~ theta0 - theta1/( 1 + exp( tau - time_to_AD )),
                   theta0 ~ 1 + (1||study/subj_id),
                   theta1 ~ 1 + (1||study/subj_id),
                   tau ~ 1 + (1||study/subj_id),
                   nl = TRUE),
               data = dat_smm, 
               prior = prior_spec,
               chain = 1,
               thin = 5,
               iter = 500,
               save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE)
)
summary(smm_fit)
```

## DSMM model
```{r}
# data
dat_dsmm = demo_dat
dat_dsmm = dat_dsmm[order(dat_dsmm$study, dat_dsmm$subj_id, dat_dsmm$age), ]
# centering age at MCI conversion at 77 
dat_dsmm$age_event77 = dat_dsmm$age_event - 77

# prior specification
## we used the estimates from the SMM model above as the priors
beta_smm = summary(smm_fit)$fixed %>% round(2) %>% suppressWarnings()
prior_spec <- eval(parse(text = paste0(
  "prior(normal(", beta_smm["theta0_Intercept", "Estimate"], ",", beta_smm["theta0_Intercept", "Est.Error"], "), nlpar = 'theta0') +  prior(normal(", beta_smm["theta1_Intercept", "Estimate"], ",",  beta_smm["theta1_Intercept", "Est.Error"], "), nlpar = 'theta1') + prior(normal(", beta_smm["tau_Intercept", "Estimate"], ",", beta_smm["tau_Intercept", "Est.Error"], "), nlpar = 'tau') + prior(normal(0, 1), nlpar = 'logD')"
)
))

set.seed(2024)
library(splines)
dsmm_fit <- brm(bf( Y ~ theta0 - theta1/( 1 + exp(tau - (t_event - I_MCI * exp(logD))) ) , 
                    theta0 ~ 1 + (1||study/subj_id),
                    theta1 ~ 1 + (1||study/subj_id),
                    tau ~ 1 + (1||study/subj_id),
                    logD ~ apoe4carrier + sex + ns(age_event77, 3) + apoe4carrier:sex + apoe4carrier:ns(age_event77, 3) + (1||study/subj_id),
                    nl = TRUE),
                data = dat_dsmm, 
                prior = prior_spec,
                chains = 1,
                thin = 5,
                iter = 500,
                save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE)
)
summary(dsmm_fit)
```
